name: veda digestive
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (Maida) (35.6%), Wheat flour (Atta) (19.7%), Refined palm oil, Sugar, Wheat bran (4.7%), Liquid glucose, Raising agents [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii), INS 450(i)], Maltodextrin, Wheat fibre (1.2%), Milk solids, Iodized salt, Emulsifiers [INS 322(i), INS 471, INS 472e], Malt extract, Ginger (0.09%), Cardamom (0.09%), Tulsi (0.03%), Mulethi (0.03%), Ashwagandha (0.03%) and Flour treatment agent (INS 223). Contains added flavour(s) (Natural flavours and natural flavouring substances and nature identical flavouring substances and artificial flavouring substances - Vanilla).
